name: damlevels-data
title: DamLevels-Data: daily storage of Tunisia's 36 large dams, 2014-2025
description: Provenance-traced daily storage observations, every printed Page 1 and Page 2 column (inflows, releases, fill, water levels, capacities, siltation, rainfall, evaporation) as one row per dam and bulletin, qualified inter-dam transfer facts, dam metadata, QA results and GIS layers reconstructed from the DGBGTH bulletins published by ONAGRI. Current quality indicators: qa/kpi/results.

resources.name: storage
resources.description: Primary Page 1 storage observations only; exactly one intended record per governed dam/date.

resources.name: transfers
resources.description: Page 3 inter-dam transfer and Sejnane accounting facts, authority PROBABLE. Time semantics: in all rows date = bulletin_date (the bulletin date D) and effective_date_rule = SAME_DAY, as recorded by the selected Page 3 product. This conflicts with the DamLevels ontology (DLO 0.3): the 'today' amount is the amount over day D-1 (DAY_BEFORE_BULLETIN), and current_season_to_date / previous_season_to_date are cumulative totals from 1 September up to day D-1 (SEASON_TO_DATE), not daily amounts. The published fields are kept as printed; see docs/known_issues.md.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date as stored by the selected Page 3 product: equal to bulletin_date (the bulletin date D) in all rows, with effective_date_rule SAME_DAY. It is not the day the amount refers to: under DLO 0.3 'today' is the amount over day D-1 and season-to-date measures are totals from 1 September up to day D-1.

fields.name: variable
fields.description: Reported Page 3 measure: today (amount over day D-1), current_season_to_date or previous_season_to_date (cumulative totals up to day D-1, not daily amounts).

fields.name: previous_hydraulic_year_end_water_level_m
fields.description: Water level at the end of the previous hydraulic year, m (Annee hydraulique precedente: plan d'eau). NOT the current level; previous hydraulic year (1 September to 31 August); changes on the bulletin of 2 September. DLO: p2_cote_plan_eau_m.

fields.name: previous_hydraulic_year_end_storage_mm3
fields.description: Storage at the end of the previous hydraulic year, Mm3, printed with 2 decimals; equals the Page 1 storage of the bulletin of 1 September. NOT the current storage; previous hydraulic year (1 September to 31 August); changes on the bulletin of 2 September. DLO: p2_volume_actuel_mm3.

fields.name: previous_full_hydraulic_year_inflow_mm3
fields.description: Inflow over the whole previous hydraulic year, Mm3; previous hydraulic year (1 September to 31 August); changes on the bulletin of 2 September. DLO: p2_apport_annee_prec_mm3.

fields.name: previous_full_hydraulic_year_outflow_mm3
fields.description: Withdrawal (soutirage) over the whole previous hydraulic year, Mm3; previous hydraulic year (1 September to 31 August); changes on the bulletin of 2 September. DLO: p2_soutirage_annee_prec_mm3.

fields.name: water_level_current_m
fields.description: Current water level, m (Cote plan d'eau), state on day D. This is the current level.

fields.name: storage_current_total_corresponding_p2_mm3
fields.description: Storage corresponding to the current level, Mm3 (Volume correspondant), state on day D; the Page 2 copy of Page 1 storage.

fields.name: storage_current_exploitable_mm3
fields.description: Usable storage corresponding to the current level, Mm3 (Volume correspondant utilisable), state on day D.

fields.name: outflow_reporting_interval_p2_mm3
fields.description: Withdrawal over day D-1, Mm3 (Soutirage du <D-1>); the Page 2 copy of the Page 1 current release.

fields.name: inflow_reporting_interval_p2_mm3
fields.description: Inflow over day D-1, Mm3 (Apport du <D-1>); the Page 2 copy of the Page 1 inflow.

fields.name: inflow_month_to_date_p2_mm3
fields.description: Inflow month to date through day D-1, Mm3 (Apport du mois). Physical column 23 up to 2024-04-26; blank afterwards.

fields.name: evaporation_reporting_interval_mm3
fields.description: Evaporation over day D-1, Mm3. Physical column 23 from 2024-04-27; blank before.

fields.name: rainfall_reporting_interval_mm
fields.description: Rainfall, mm (Pluv), DLO time rule day D-1 (medium confidence). Printed n,d is left blank.

fields.name: p2_rs_unresolved_prohibited
fields.description: Value printed under R.S. (g/l). Its meaning is not confirmed by a printed legend, so no variable is asserted; kept as printed.
